Why I Stopped Mocking DbContext

Why I Stopped Mocking DbContext

Mocking DbContext gives you tests that pass and queries that fail. An in-memory provider is closer, and a real database in a container is closer still, which is where I ended up after two years of chasing false positives across three projects.

The test that lied

var mock = new Mock<AppDbContext>();
mock.Setup(c => c.Orders).Returns(orders);

// passes, and proves nothing

Complexity is O(n2) in the worst case.
